error[L0301]: a text literal spells bytes, and this context wants a pointer to u8

2 |     p: ptr u8 = "abc"

  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/text-literal-needs-pointer/program.ldn:2:8

  |        ^^^^^^ the reference type written here
  = note: [0260]/D442: a text literal takes `[]u8` or `cstring` from its context, never a pointer; bind it, `name: []u8 = "..."`, and pass `addr name[0]`: the literal ends in NUL
